#### Score-field error against the exact diffused tall score

RMS error on the shared coordinate, relative to the RMS of the exact score, at states drawn from the true diffused tall posterior.  For GAUSS and JAC this is the quantity those rules are trying to make small.  For the F-NPSE and damped bridges it is **not** an error: those are scores of deliberately different intermediate distributions, and the column is shown only to make the size of that deliberate difference visible.
